name: NYC Human Powered Boat Launches
description: This dataset lists 63 human-powered boat launch sites across New York City, such as kayak and canoe access points at parks, landings, and clubs. Each record includes the site name, its borough (Queens, Manhattan, the Bronx, Brooklyn, or Staten Island), a reference link (mostly NYC Parks pages), and longitude and latitude coordinates. The data covers all five boroughs, with Queens and Manhattan accounting for the largest shares of sites. It can be used to map launch locations, compare waterfront access between boroughs, plan paddling trips, build navigation tools for kayakers and canoeists, or study equity in recreational access to the city's waterways.
